The lifecycle phase of a Build.


<a name="BuildStatusPhase_BUILD_STATUS_PHASE_UNSPECIFIED"></a>

```go
const (
    BuildStatusPhase_BUILD_STATUS_PHASE_UNSPECIFIED BuildStatusPhase_BuildStatusPhase = 0
    // Waiting for a trigger event or dependency to be ready.
    BuildStatusPhase_BUILD_STATUS_PHASE_PENDING BuildStatusPhase_BuildStatusPhase = 1
    // A BuildRun is currently executing.
    BuildStatusPhase_BUILD_STATUS_PHASE_RUNNING BuildStatusPhase_BuildStatusPhase = 2
    // The most recent BuildRun completed successfully.
    // Image has been pushed to the registry.
    BuildStatusPhase_BUILD_STATUS_PHASE_SUCCEEDED BuildStatusPhase_BuildStatusPhase = 3
    // The most recent BuildRun failed.
    // Check execution_ref for BuildRun details.
    BuildStatusPhase_BUILD_STATUS_PHASE_FAILED BuildStatusPhase_BuildStatusPhase = 4
    // The BuildRun was cancelled before completion.
    BuildStatusPhase_BUILD_STATUS_PHASE_CANCELLED BuildStatusPhase_BuildStatusPhase = 5
)
```

```go
const (
```

```go
    DomainPhase_DOMAIN_PHASE_FAILED DomainPhase_DomainPhase = 4
)
```

<a name="DomainTLSStrategy"></a>
## type DomainTLSStrategy

DomainTLSStrategy

Controls which cert provisioning path the Domain controller takes.

```
platform — The platform wildcard cert (*.dev.host) already covers this
           host via a DNS01 ClusterIssuer. Controller emits DomainClaim +
           DomainMapping only — no Certificate work is needed.

custom   — Client-owned zone (e.g. client-a.co.za). Controller emits
           Issuer + DomainClaim + DomainMapping + Certificate. HTTP01
           ACME challenge via the nginx solver in the tenant namespace.
```

```go
type DomainTLSStrategy struct {

    // strategy is the selected TLS provisioning path.
    Strategy DomainTLSStrategy_DomainTLSStrategy `protobuf:"varint,1,opt,name=strategy,proto3,enum=blanketops.common.v1.DomainTLSStrategy_DomainTLSStrategy" json:"strategy,omitempty"`
    // contains filtered or unexported fields
```
